$description: Platform tokens for ios (iPhone and iPad). Emitted under [data-platform='ios'] and in the native ios theme objects.

xs.$description: Minimum control size on iOS, 28x28 pt. Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility. Density never changes it on iOS (docs/contracts/tokens.md, order of the layer).

sm.$description: Small bordered button on iOS. Value from memory, unverified: the HIG pages give no number for it. Density never changes it on iOS (docs/contracts/tokens.md, order of the layer).

md.$description: Default control size on iOS, 44x44 pt. Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility; Liquid audit (docs/reports/audit/liquid-guidelines.md), "Sizes and type". Density never changes it on iOS (docs/contracts/tokens.md, order of the layer).

lg.$description: Large button on iOS. Value from memory, unverified: the HIG pages give no number for it. Density never changes it on iOS (docs/contracts/tokens.md, order of the layer).

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): nothing interactive is smaller than 24 by 24 CSS px, including handles (via a hit area). The same on every platform; no platform changes it (DECISIONS.md, size.target-min is the 24px floor on every platform). The platform touch target is size.target.

target.$description: Touch target on iOS: a button needs a hit region of at least 44x44 pt. Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons, and https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility, default control size 44x44 pt. The same value as size.touch.ios.

ios.$description: Touch target on iOS, in points. Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility, default control size 44x44 pt.

android.$description: Touch target on Android, in dp. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Targets and spacing": at least 48 by 48dp.

none.$description: None 0. The vendor publishes no corner scale (Liquid audit (docs/reports/audit/liquid-guidelines.md), "Shape": concentric corners, capsules for controls); this platform uses the shared step values from Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape".

level0.$description: Elevation level 0: key shadow 0 0 0 0, ambient shadow 0 0 0 0. Colours are the style's scrim tokens: key scrim-30 (0.3 as in the source), ambient scrim-20 (the source has 0.15; the contract has no 0.15 step). Native reads the elevation number 0. The vendor publishes no elevation levels; this platform uses the shared geometry of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/material-components/material-web/main/elevation/internal/_elevation.scss.

stiffness.$description: interactiveSpring() defaults: response 0.15, dampingFraction 0.86. Source: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/animation/interactivespring(response:dampingfraction:blendduration:). Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

damping.$description: Damping coefficient (not a ratio): ratio times 2 times the square root of stiffness times mass.

stiffness.$description: spring() defaults: response 0.5, dampingFraction 0.825. Source: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/animation/spring(response:dampingfraction:blendduration:). Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

damping.$description: Damping coefficient (not a ratio): ratio times 2 times the square root of stiffness times mass.

stiffness.$description: Derived, no vendor value: the spring() damping fraction 0.825 at 1.5 times its response (0.75). Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

damping.$description: Damping coefficient (not a ratio): ratio times 2 times the square root of stiffness times mass.

stiffness.$description: Derived, no vendor value: the interactiveSpring() response 0.15 with no bounce (damping fraction 1). Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

damping.$description: Damping coefficient (not a ratio): ratio times 2 times the square root of stiffness times mass.

Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

Converted at mass 1: stiffness (2 pi / response) squared, damping 4 pi times the damping fraction over the response, the conversion the Spring page shows (duration 0.5, bounce 0.3 gives 157.9 and 17.6).

top.$description: Safe area at the top. CSS reads env(safe-area-inset-top); native reads 0 and the safe area provider supplies the live value.

bottom.$description: Safe area at the bottom. CSS reads env(safe-area-inset-bottom); native reads 0.

start.$description: Safe area at the inline start. The build maps it to env(safe-area-inset-left), or right under :dir(rtl). Native reads 0.

end.$description: Safe area at the inline end. The build maps it to env(safe-area-inset-right), or left under :dir(rtl). Native reads 0.

keyboard.$description: Height of the on screen keyboard. CSS reads env(keyboard-inset-height), which needs the page to opt in to the virtual keyboard overlay. Native reads 0.
